_notes: All referenced file paths are project-relative; input images stay shared at their canonical paths.
scope.source is independent of this file and prepare_spec. Preferred source shape: schema 1, kind reference-board-scope, asset_views with exact asset_id/view_id/role entries.
Upstream BOMs may instead provide explicit reference_views, or asset_proposals[].approved_reference_views as view_id/role objects. Names and view aliases are never inferred.
The upstream source, scope, prepare plan and object descriptions must cover exactly the same asset/views. Unresolved views or placeholder designs block production.
native_binding may be omitted until the actual host tool schema is known; map each prepared page before claiming it.
Each page gets one exclusive claim before native invocation. A pending/unknown call keeps its original claim; record/recover the original result without resubmission.
Crop ROIs must be observed, not copied automatically from layout slots. Frozen subject/detail pixel requirements are inherited unchanged.
Final per-crop reviews bind the actual cropped image path/hash, orientation, verdict, concrete observation and inspection_source_ref.

Same-asset views split across pages require qualified identity_master/source_review bindings. Same-page multiview creation remains joint design exploration until an explicit cross-view comparison is recorded.

review also accepts {reviews:[...],cross_view_reviews:[{asset_id,verdict,observation,source_ref,images:[{view_id,image:{path,sha256}}]}]}. Every scoped multiview asset needs a separate comparison bound to all current crop hashes before completion.
bind-session updates only operational context/history. Existing pending claims keep their original session, dispatch and call identity; new sessions reconcile them without regeneration.
A source-bound declared scope and recorded visual verdicts do not supply human approval, independently verified native execution or 3D quality acceptance.
